title: Nana's Leo Book
author: RambleBook
blurb: Leo is 6 years old — curious, brave, and giggly all the way through. In this story, Leo and Nana fly a cardboard rocket to a moon made of mac and cheese. A keepsake storybook about Leo, made for Nana to keep, to show, and to read aloud.
message: For Nana — Leo made you a book. Merry Christmas!
makerLine: Made with RambleBook · Shelved at Narristotle, the bookstore
